concerns.text: Functional requirement FR-009 (CPU‑only execution) is not covered by any task. No task verifies that the pipeline runs without GPU/CUDA dependencies, violating the constitution’s reproducibility principle.

Functional requirement FR-010 (pipeline must complete within 6 hours) lacks a concrete verification task. T104’s verification mentions finishing within the budget but does not record or assert the runtime, making the requirement untestable.
Success criterion SC-001 (model R² measured against a random‑prediction baseline) is not addressed by any task. No artifact is produced that records the baseline R² = 0 comparison.

Success criterion SC-002 (feature‑importance rankings compared to permutation importance) is only partially covered by T102, which computes permutation importance, but there is no task that performs the comparison or produces a verification report.
Success criterion SC-003 (confidence‑interval coverage measurement) is left deferred and no task generates an artifact that quantifies CI coverage, leaving the criterion untestable.
Constitution clause III (Data Hygiene) requires checksums for all data files, yet no task records cryptographic hashes for raw or processed data artifacts.
Constitution clause I (Reproducibility) mandates that all random seeds be pinned and recorded. No task ensures seed pinning or documents the seed values used across scripts.
